opening.argument: The segment centers on restaurant food for March Madness gatherings: Texas Roadhouse appetizers for family and friends, takeout ordering, and a catering menu. The visible table of prepared dishes reinforces that ordinary food-purchase setting. The mobile app and rewards are presented in the same context. Downloading the app and creating a profile brings a free appetizer on a later visit, while paying through the app brings a $5 coupon. Those are restaurant loyalty offers tied to visits and purchases, not promises of wealth or returns. Although the segment discusses profile creation and email or text lists, it does not present a credential request or another scam mechanism. Its purpose is to promote restaurant ordering and related offers.

citations.quote: Texas Roadhouse have plenty of appetizers that will be a slam dunk when it comes to feeding your family and friends.
Yes, we have a new 2020 catering menu.
Just for downloading the app and creating a profile, you get a free appetizer for your next visit.
If you pay with your mobile app, you get a $5 coupon.
